concept: The culmination of a documentary legacy, grandest and fullest composition: a monumental very thick open collected-works volume on a formal reading pedestal, one anatomically correct hand resting firmly flat on its right page, with a precise symmetrical wall of indexed archive books behind. A classic shaded desk lamp above-left illuminates the open pages. Cool silver-grey ivory relief, crisp straight edges and highly ordered shelves, substantial book block and layered pages, calm institutional authority. No face, no readable writing or letters on pages or spines. More monumental and full than earlier icons, with dominant giant book.
